cancellation_summary: Full price will be charged for cancellations, tour date changes, and “no shows” unless we receive advance notice as follows: One to five guests – 24 hours; Six or more guests – 48 hours; Private charters – 72 hours.
meeting_point: Major hotels and resorts in Kona and Waikoloa
accessibility: Our vehicles cannot accommodate wheelchairs, scooters, or walkers.
description: Explore Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden, swim at Kulanipia private waterfalls, visit the majestic Waipio Valley Lookout, and the stunning Akaka Falls on the Hamakua Coast of the Big Island of Hawaii on this full day of fun and exciting adventure. Discover the island’s diverse natural beauty, including multiple waterfalls, lush rain forests, and rugged sea cliffs as your guide shares history and legends.
what_is_included: Guests are served a local-style picnic lunch with assorted juices, snacks, and bottled water. In addition, all park entrance fees, jackets, and rain gear are also included
itinerary:
- Begin with a visit to the Waipio Valley Lookout, passing through the historic Parker Ranch. Enjoy breathtaking views of towering sea cliffs, a mile-long black-sand beach, and the sparkling Pacific Ocean.

- Drive along the scenic Hamakua Coast to marvel at the famous Akaka Falls, where water cascades hundreds of feet into a lush ravine.

- Explore the Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden in Onomea Bay. Stroll rainforest trails crossing bubbling streams and waterfalls, with views of the rugged Pacific coastline. Discover over 2,000 species of exotic tropical plants and orchids in this lush garden setting.

- Take a refreshing swim under the 120-foot Kulaniapia private waterfalls, Hawaii’s largest privately accessible waterfalls (weather permitting).

- Visit Rainbow Falls, an 80-foot cascade framed by a giant banyan tree.

- Conclude your adventure with a scenic drive along Saddle Road, nestled between Mauna Kea, the world’s tallest sea mountain, and Mauna Loa, the world’s most massive mountain.
highlight_description: Explore the Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden, swim at Kulanipia private waterfalls, and discover the scenic Waipio Valley Lookout, Akaka Falls, and Rainbow Falls
check_in_details: We pick up from all resorts and hotels in Keauhou, Kona, Waikoloa, and the Kohala Coast between 7:00 a.m. and 8:30 a.m. Actual pickup times vary depending on location. The tour duration is approximately 9 -11 hours.
what_to_bring: Bring a swimsuit, towels, and wear comfortable summer clothing. Covered walking shoes and water shoes are recommended.
restrictions: Guests should not be physically challenged or unable to walk short to moderate distances on uneven terrain. We sometimes encounter cool, wet, or muddy conditions. Ages 5 and older are required. Our vehicles cannot accommodate wheelchairs, scooters, or walkers.
faqs:
**How much hiking do we do?**
A: There are some short and moderate hikes of no more than 1 mile throughout the tour. Guests must be able to walk on uneven, sloped, and potentially slippery grounds on this tour.

**Will we get to swim in the waterfalls?**
A: Yes, if weather permits you can swim at a private waterfall on this tour.

**Does this tour drive down into the Waipio Valley?**
A: This tour will only visit the Waipio Valley Lookout. It doesn’t take guests down into the valley.

**What's the difference between Big Island Waterfalls Adventure and Circle Island Tour?**
A: Both tours showcase Rainbow Falls, Akaka Falls, and Waipio Valley Lookout. The Circle Island Tour also visits a Kona coffee farm, Punalu'u black sand beach, and 1.5 hours at Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park, while the Waterfalls Adventure adds the Hawai‘i Tropical Botanical Gardens, a private swim at Kulaniapia private falls, and a return over the scenic Saddle Road.
